Game Overview

Find the Cheese is a animal game built around navigate twisting mazes in a strategic quest for cheese, while evading a relentless cat. With only three chances to succeed, plan your moves carefully to outsmart your feline foe and advance through increasingly challenging levels. Every turn holds new risks and rewards. Can you outwit the cat and claim victory?
